qc.label_under_test: A piece partway through an extreme verdict word or phrase, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: inner chunks of a long or ALL-CAPS intense adjective or adverb split into several tokens (INC-RED-IBLE, F-ANT-ASTIC, HORR-IBLE, extra-ordinary, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно) and the opening words of a superlative idiom after a praising lead-in (state- of the art, world-class, show-stopping, out of this world). Also, more weakly, ' nothing' right after is/was opening a judgement of something (was nothing special, is nothing short of, is nothing to sneeze at), but not after a comma or in literal uses (nothing in the fridge, nothing to do). Quiet on intense words that arrive as one whole token (amazing, incredible, breathtaking), on mild verdicts without 'nothing' (mediocre, pretty good), and on the same opening words used literally (the top of the hill, around the world).

neighbours.label: A piece partway through an extreme verdict word or phrase, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: inner chunks of a long or ALL-CAPS intense adjective or adverb split into several tokens (INC-RED-IBLE, F-ANT-ASTIC, HORR-IBLE, extra-ordinary, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно) and the opening words of a superlative idiom after a praising lead-in (state- of the art, world-class, show-stopping, out of this world). Also, more weakly, ' nothing' right after is/was opening a judgement of something (was nothing special, is nothing short of, is nothing to sneeze at), but not after a comma or in literal uses (nothing in the fridge, nothing to do). Quiet on intense words that arrive as one whole token (amazing, incredible, breathtaking), on mild verdicts without 'nothing' (mediocre, pretty good), and on the same opening words used literally (the top of the hill, around the world). Also quiet on long neutral words split into pieces, in caps or not (photosynthesis, INTERNATIONALIZATION, CALIFORNIA): the chunk must belong to a verdict word. Only weak on first-rate and top-notch.
fire: That concert last night was absolutely INCREDIBLE, I still can't stop thinking about it.
Honestly, the food at that little place was FANTASTIC from start to finish.
The customer service on that flight was HORRIBLE and nobody even apologized.
Her performance in the final act was truly extraordinary.
Этот фильм просто замечательный, я посмотрю его ещё раз.
Задача оказалась чрезвычайно сложной даже для опытных инженеров.
The new lab is fitted out with gorgeous, state of the art equipment.
They hired a brilliant, world-class chef to run the kitchen.
quiet: That concert last night was amazing, I still can't stop thinking about it.
Honestly, the food at that little place was pretty good from start to finish.
The customer service on that flight was mediocre and nobody even apologized.
Her performance in the final act was breathtaking.
The textbook chapter on photosynthesis was assigned for Monday.
The INTERNATIONALIZATION team meets every Thursday at noon.
We drove through CALIFORNIA on the way to visit my cousins.
The new lab is on the third floor, at the end of the hall.
